Every Time Around
Click 🎧 to listen.
Listen to a conversation between two students. The boy is discussing his opinion about the music for a world they are building. Listen carefully. You will hear the conversation only once. After listening, you will answer four questions about the conversation and the evidence the boy gives to support his opinion. As you listen, you may take notes.
Listen to the Conversation
1 QUESTION 1:
Why does the boy want to keep the same main tune?
2 QUESTION 2:
Where did the boy watch a whole band play this way?
3 QUESTION 3:
What does the boy say the band did with the fiddle tune?
4 QUESTION 4:
What does the boy think the music should make people feel?
Answer all 4 questions to submit.
Choose the best answer for each question. You may change your answers before submitting.
SMART SUPPORT:
Go back to the conversation. Identify why the boy keeps the same main tune. Identify where he watched the festival band. Identify what the band did to the fiddle tune each time around. Identify what he says the music should make people feel.
